transcript.content: Which high-risk user requirements are not currently verified? For each one, give the requirement ID and the reason.

content.text: I'll start by pulling the high-risk requirements: the FRA rows that assess URSs and are rated HIGH.

input.query: SELECT r.ri_id, r.risk_class, r.sev, t.link_type, t.src_type, t.tgt_type, t.tgt_id, r.failure_mode FROM pd.val_risk_item r JOIN pd.trace_link t ON t.src_id = r.ri_id WHERE r.ri_id LIKE 'FRA%' OR t.link_type='ASSESSES' ORDER BY r.ri_id
SELECT item_id, spec_level, doc_no, sys_id, req_category, item_text FROM pd.val_spec_item WHERE spec_level='URS' ORDER BY item_id
SELECT * FROM pd.trace_link ORDER BY link_type, src_id

input.query: SELECT tc.tc_id, tc.protocol_id, tc.method, tc.title, p.ptype, p.status FROM pd.val_test_case tc LEFT JOIN pd.val_protocol p ON p.protocol_id=tc.protocol_id ORDER BY tc.tc_id
SELECT e.exec_id, e.tc_id, e.target_id, e.exec_dt, e.executed_by, e.reviewed_by, e.result, e.actual_result FROM pd.val_test_exec e ORDER BY e.tc_id, e.target_id, e.exec_dt, e.exec_id
SELECT equip_id, equip_type, model, room, sys_id, cal_due_dt FROM pd.equipment ORDER BY sys_id, equip_id
SELECT cc_no, open_dt, title, change_class, status, impl_dt, impact_assessment FROM pd.qms_change_control ORDER BY cc_no
